project.premise: A lighthouse keeper on a fog-bound island begins receiving letters addressed to her in her own handwriting, dated years before she was born.

arcs.description: Mara catalogs the impossible letters and, against her instinct for solitude, rows to the mainland to trace the postmarks — pulling a reclusive archivist into her orbit.
The letters' origin unravels a family debt tied to the lighthouse itself, forcing Mara to choose between keeping the flame lit and finally leaving the island.

threads.description: Who is writing the letters, and how do they predate Mara's birth?
The lighthouse's automation grant expires at the end of the season, threatening Mara's post.
Whether Mara can trust the archivist Idris, who knows more about the island than he admits.

characters.name: Mara Vane
characters.description: The island's last human lighthouse keeper; guarded, precise, and quietly afraid of what leaving would cost her.

characters.name: Idris Coll
characters.description: A mainland archivist with a personal stake in the lighthouse's history that he is slow to reveal.
